title: Luxuriously Lacquered Portuguese Beef Shin Stew
description: A winey, crunchy, and comforting Portuguese dish featuring beef shin in a lacquer glaze, this stew is perfect for a cold winter's night. It is a satvik-friendly meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef shin chunks and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
Add the lacquer glaze and stir to combine.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
